authority: main_implementation plan.md P07.3; api design.md sections 3.8 and 4.5
finding: The current dataset snapshot manifest pins exact content bytes and a retrieval time, but does not record a native object version, forecast issue/valid clocks, or evidence that the archived original was accessible at a past decision cutoff. The pure temporal selector requires these fields. Mapping absent fields to defaults would create false historical availability.
required_next_increment: Persist source-native issue and valid clocks, provider publication/availability proof, and an archived-original object version or equivalent immutable retention proof
Load those records under tenant and project authorization, validate every timestamp and source identity, then invoke the existing P07 temporal selector
Return inconclusive when the original archival proof is absent; never substitute a later reanalysis or future-issued forecast
Exercise local database, RLS, exact-byte retrieval, and historical negative cases before claiming P07.3 acceptance
implemented_increment: Newly acquired validated observations get an append-only server-stamped archive entry with pinned SHA-256 bytes. The project-scoped selector re-reads and verifies those bytes and rejects cutoff dates before publication, availability, retrieval or archival. This is application-level integrity and timing, not native object lock or independent provider availability proof.
